faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Puntr is a community platform for sports fans to publish predictions before kick-off, then see each pick locked, automatically graded and kept in a public record. It gives your sporting knowledge a transparent track record.
faq.a2: PuntPoints are a loyalty scheme. You earn them for activity such as confirming your email, posting picks, settled picks and inviting friends, never for winning. You can redeem them for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks on the Rewards page. They have no cash value and cannot be bought.
faq.a3: Yes. Members get a personal invite link. When a friend joins and posts a first pick, you both earn PuntPoints after a short waiting period. There are no cash payments for referrals.
faq.a4: Yes. Puntr is free during the Founding 100 launch. Any paid features later will be announced first and never switched on without notice.
faq.a5: Every member’s record shows settled picks and performance context, including units, ROI and sample size. Past results are not a guide to future outcomes. Gamble responsibly: 0800 006 008.
faq.a6: No. PuntPoints have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for cash. You can only redeem them for the rewards on the Rewards page.
faq.a7: No. Puntr does not accept bets, set odds or hold betting funds. It helps members record, review and compare sports predictions.
